title: Identify regulatory risks for new features
text: I’m a PM scoping a [feature] for financial services. Research recent regulatory guidance in the US, UK, and EU around the use of [feature] in customer-facing products. Summarize by region with citations. Output: A table of legal considerations to flag for our legal team and product design implications.
problem: Keperluan teknikal untuk “Identify regulatory risks for new features” belum dirangka atau diuji.
use: Mereka bentuk produk dan sistem digital
output: Jadual berstruktur; ketepatan angka dan sumber mesti diperiksa.
hook: Idea produk ada, tetapi skop, aliran pengguna atau ujian belum tersusun? Fokus: Identify regulatory risks for new features.
solution: Tugasan: Identify regulatory risks for new features. Tetapkan keperluan fungsi, aliran pengguna, skema data, sempadan keselamatan dan kriteria ujian sebelum membangunkan output.
cta: Jalankan pada spesifikasi sebenar; uji fungsi, kes tepi dan keselamatan sebelum digunakan.
